headline: Anthropic announces official voting information and election results for Claude ahead of US midterms
summary: In an Oct. 14 post, Anthropic described planned state-specific voting information from Democracy Works and official election-result answers, and reported service-specific conversation statistics from a one-week sample. It also summarized an ISD and McCain Institute pressure test in the US, Israel and Brazil: single harmful requests were reportedly refused, but a coordinated campaign split into benign-looking steps could evade defenses. Anthropic says it added multi-step misuse classifiers and other safeguards. The partner methods, underlying data and post-change effectiveness were not independently reviewed; product rollout remains unverified.
